newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUMA'S NELES WINS ITS LARGEST ORDER.
newsitem.headline: RAUMA'S NELES WINS ITS LARGEST ORDER.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said in a statement on Monday its Neles-Jamesbury had won its largest-ever single order -- supply control and manual shut-off valves for APRIL group's pulp and paper operations in Indonesia.
It did not give the value of the deal but a Rauma official said its previously largest orders had been worth "roughly 50 to 60 million markka".
"This is Neles-Jamesbury's largest induvidual contract ever, and further strengthens the business group's position as the leading valve supplier to he Asian pulp and paper industry," Rauma said.
The contract would include several projects which will be carried out during 1996-1998, it said.

It said APRIL was expanding its Riaupulp mill capacity from 750,000 tonnes per year to one million tonnes by end-1997 and building a new 600,000 tonne-per-year uncoated woodfree paper mill whose first paper machine would be started in the first half of 1998.
